svg.text: Feasibility & Risk Mitigation
Each risk is answered by a design decision, not by hope
Why this is buildable
No model training — pretrained inference only
All components are open-source and permissively
licensed (Apache-2.0 backbone)
Runs on commodity laptop hardware
Datasets exist publicly for validation
Why this is deployable
Single offline installer, no runtime downloads
No licence server, no telemetry, no cloud call
GPU optional — CPU fallback path exists
Integrates with standard GIS formats the end
user already works in (LAS, GeoTIFF)
Why this is adoptable
Drop in a video — no flight-plan redesign needed
Works with footage already being captured today
Outputs open into QGIS, CloudCompare, Blender
Optional RTK/PPK path for survey-grade users
without changing the core workflow
Challenges and the strategy that answers each

g.text: Single strip is a degenerate geometry — SfM may not converge
Pose-free feed-forward initialisation, which needs no prior poses at all
Near-collinear flight can tilt the whole model
Gravity / Z-up prior in bundle adjustment plus an explicit degeneracy guard
GPS position priors as factors inside BA, anchoring the solution to metric reality
Limited GPU memory on field laptops
Submap windowing — peak memory bounded by window size, not video length
Motion blur and redundant frames in video
Baseline-driven keyframe selection with sharpest-in-window rejection of blur
Occluded surfaces a single pass can never see
Tag as INFERRED, exclude from measurement, and plan a corrective pass
Segmentation masks vehicles and people before fusion
Bounded-resolution inference, feed-forward rather than iterative, progressive output

svg.text: PUBLISHED PRECEDENT FOR THE TIME BUDGET
Feed-forward UAV reconstruction of 2,000 images in ~5 min — arXiv:2608.28288
ON ACCURACY, STATED HONESTLY
Standalone GPS is bias-limited. Relative and absolute reported separately.
